title: Working out magnification
caption: The cell is 60 µm across but 90 mm across in the image. Converting 90 mm to 90 000 µm and dividing by 60 µm gives a magnification of ×1500. The scale bar shows how long 20 µm is at this magnification.
alt: An oval cell with a nucleus, a bracket above it marking the image length of 90 mm, a scale bar labelled 20 µm, and the calculation: 90 000 µm divided by 60 µm equals ×1500.
description: The cell's image is 90 mm across.
The scale bar is a third of the cell's width, because 20 µm is a third of 60 µm.
